name: lg_ocean_palace_19f
doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/pre_scene_19f.* (the owner's snes9x capture in the Ocean Palace's aftermath, spliced over a base teleported from ch22): Jackie's ch22 (loc 194, storyline BD) played through the Ocean Palace on the oracle under the rule, by the oracle's own collision and scripts (tools: an 8-direction oracle search toward a flag / location / tile, tools/battle_pilot.py for the fights): 194's cut to 19F and back (BD -> C3); the switch puzzle on $7F0162 (196's bottom-right switch, bit 1: 197's left bridge; 197's inner switch, bit 0: 195's lower door; 196's middle rooms obj22 / obj26, bits 4-6; 19C's bridge, bit 7 and $7F015A bit 3); 198, the shaft 199, 19F's second scene (C3 -> C6); the elevator 19B -> 1A0; 1A2, 19C, 19D, 19E (its fight: C9); 19F's event, the lost fight and Lavos's chamber 1A7 (CB, $7F01EC = 1), back to 19F; cut 508 frames before 19F's CHANGELOC 1F4 -- the capture's own place: from here the chain 19F -> 1F4 -> 1F5 -> 1EE -> 1F5 -> 165 -> 1F4 -> 182 -> 1ED -> 10F -> 1A9 runs on the capture's frames to f6277. 46 of the steps are heal pokes in the fights of the elevator and of 19E (a seat under half its HP set to its max: $5E30 + $80 x seat := $5E32's; a test fixture, as lg_end_core_defeated's -- the pilot alone loses them); the fights of 19F and 1A7 are lost unhealed, as the story has them. Its first 119 steps are lg_ocean_palace_1a7_pre (split out 2026-10-26 for the cutscene moment M7: the same steps, the same state).
